LM2596S-5 existing filter edit:
- Changed existing C3 Value to 470uF; added fresh Device:C C4=100nF across +5V/GND and C5=10uF across Vin/GND downstream of D1.
- Properties Value field (380,413), OK (758,788); chooser Device:C then OK (698,828).
- At editing zoom, C4 center (695,428), endpoints y390/466, output/GND rails y327/491. C5 center (218,403), endpoints y365/441, Vin/GND rails y314/491. Wire from endpoints to rails; final overview shows junction dots.
- F1 zoom moved circuit offscreen; Home then toolbar zoom (221,86) restored usable view. Home fits page for final inspection; tools/zoom.py helps read it without modifying GUI.
- Step 28 shows clean title after Ctrl+S and saved path /home/cua/kicad_project/kicad_buck converter_circuit/kicad_buck converter_circuit.kicad_sch.
